actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.get_delivery_stats.description: Retrieve delivery statistics for the current Postmark server.
actions.get_email_bounces.description: List bounces from your Postmark server.
actions.get_email_bounces.props.count.de: Maximum number of bounces to return (max 500).
actions.get_email_bounces.props.emailFil: Filter results by bounced recipient email address.
actions.get_email_bounces.props.inactive: Filter by inactive bounces only. When not set, both active and inactive bounces are returned.
actions.get_email_bounces.props.messageI: Filter results by Postmark message ID.
actions.get_email_bounces.props.offset.d: Number of bounces to skip before returning results.
actions.get_email_bounces.props.type.des: Optional bounce type filter, for example HardBounce.
actions.send_email.description: Send a single transactional email using Postmark.
actions.send_email.props.from.descriptio: Sender email address configured in Postmark.
actions.send_email_with_template.descrip: Send an email using a Postmark template ID and template model.
actions.send_email_with_template.props.f: Sender email address configured in Postmark.
actions.send_email_with_template.props.t: JSON object used to populate the Postmark template.
auth.description: Create or copy a Postmark Server API Token from Servers → API Tokens in Postmark.
description: Transactional email platform for sending email, templates, and retrieving delivery and bounce insights.
